summary: Live navigation and warp capabilities hang without state delta
symptom: Both write calls remained running about 49 seconds and emitted no JSON result; mGBA frame count advanced but map position and canonical state hash did not change.

unexpected.predicted: Each bounded capability returns structured success or a typed failure within its frame/replan bound, with RAM position or map postcondition.
unexpected.actual: No response, no map/position/party delta, orphaned runbun_call and runbun_mcp processes until they later exited.

authority.oracle: A bounded navigator must either change the authoritative map position or return a typed no-progress failure after three unchanged input acknowledgements.
sources: canonical RAM map position and state hash

steps: Load the protected post-first-grunt fixture in a unique-port muted clone.
Verify three acknowledged inputs leave RAM position unchanged and a typed failure is returned.
reproduction.observed: Both runs returned TRANSIENT_FAILURE: adaptive route made no progress at (12,6) after 3 inputs; overworld control may be locked.

hypotheses.claim: The post-battle script still owns overworld control even though the coarse mode decoder says overworld.
hypotheses.predicted_discriminator: Different legal directions are acknowledged but none changes SaveBlock1 coordinates.

hypotheses.claim: One blocked edge alone caused the stall.
hypotheses.predicted_discriminator: Replanning through a different first edge would move the player.
hypotheses.result: falsified; three distinct replanned inputs all preserved (12,6)

root_cause.claim: follow_live_path_adaptive counted stalls per directed edge, so a globally control-locked state could consume the full replan budget by cycling first edges instead of failing after repeated zero progress.
evidence: Static source inspection showed stalled[first_edge] was the only no-progress counter.
The fixed clone replay tried three inputs with unchanged RAM coordinates and returned immediately.
alternatives_falsified: RPC read failure: canonical reads and input acknowledgements continued.
Single dynamic blocker: alternate first edges also produced no coordinate delta.

solution.contract_change: Adaptive navigation now aborts after three consecutive acknowledged inputs with no global position progress, regardless of which replanned first edge was selected.

replay.expected: Typed no-progress failure after three unchanged inputs without touching the protected live checkpoint.
replay.actual: Both unique-port clones returned the expected failure in 1.5-1.6 seconds; fixture hash remained unchanged.

domain_knowledge: A battle script can retain player control while the coarse UI decoder reports overworld and the field message box is closed.
tooling_contracts: Adaptive navigation must bound global no-progress, not only repeated use of one edge.
